# Gemflow

> Gemflow: Crystal Energy is an Android app that turns your phone into a living crystal: a real-time gemstone live wallpaper, a glowing incoming-call screen, light you guide with your finger, and a breathing companion that pulses with the stone. Coming soon to Android; iOS later.

Gemflow is made by an independent developer in Australia. It is for relaxation, meditation and ritual — not a medical product.

## Stones and frequencies

Each stone has its own living light and a matching one-hour meditation track (guqin we recorded ourselves, real singing bowls, ocean waves and one pure frequency tone):

- Ruby — root chakra color — 396 Hz: https://youtu.be/5sbERpbVyoM
- Citrine — solar plexus chakra color — 528 Hz: https://youtu.be/2jQwbFc6lPQ
- Emerald — heart chakra color — 639 Hz: https://youtu.be/Ntq4LeBtSCY
- Sapphire — throat chakra color — 741 Hz: https://youtu.be/M5VmHUEpwcw
- Amethyst — crown chakra color — 963 Hz: https://youtu.be/KeWATSzXJTw
